run_translate_pipeline: run the translate.py CLI to translate sentences from stdin using a trained XLM model
build_translation_parser: build an argparse parser for translate.py with source/target language and model path arguments
test_translate_batch: test the translate.py module with batched sentence translation from stdin to output file
refactor_translate_main: refactor the translate.py main function to support streaming input instead of reading all lines at once
review_translate_encoder_decoder: review the translate.py encoder and decoder loading logic with pretrained model weights
